scopes.name: staker-deposit-liquidity-allocation
scopes.description: Public pool, position mint, tier setup, and StakeToken allocation that initializes a persisted Deposit liquidity value.

scopes.name: staker-deposit-liquidity-repeat
scopes.description: Immediate zero-reward control followed by accrued CollectReward batches of 1, 10, and 100 calls, exercising repeated Deposit liquidity reads and writes.

scopes.name: staker-deposit-liquidity-query
scopes.description: Pure GetDepositLiquidityAsString reads repeated 1, 10, and 100 times; query-only output is not a paid transaction price.

scopes.name: staker-deposit-liquidity-lifecycle
scopes.description: Public UnStakeToken removes the Deposit and reports final staked-liquidity state.

scopes.name: staker-tick-gross-allocation
scopes.description: Two public staked positions share tick boundaries; the measured second StakeToken updates persisted staked tick gross.

scopes.name: staker-tick-gross-crossing
label_prefixes: Remaining staker tick gross repeat crossing
scopes.description: A real exact-in pool swap crosses the shared initialized staked boundary and reads staked tick gross during tick-cross accounting.

scopes.name: staker-tick-gross-lifecycle
scopes.description: Public UnStakeToken calls remove both shared-boundary deposits and report final staker liquidity.

scopes.name: staker-incentive-rate-allocation
scopes.description: Public CreateExternalIncentive initializes a Q128-scaled rate whose value exceeds 128 bits while preserving the 90-day schedule.

scopes.name: staker-incentive-rate-query
scopes.description: Pure GetIncentiveRewardPerSecondX128 reads repeated 1, 10, and 100 times; query-only output is not a paid transaction price.

scopes.name: staker-incentive-rate-cancel
label_prefixes: Remaining staker incentive rate lifecycle CancelExternalIncentive
scopes.description: A sibling reward-token incentive is cancelled before start through the public API; reward and GNS refund state is printed outside the metric window.

scopes.name: staker-incentive-rate-repeat
scopes.description: Pre-start zero control followed by accrued CollectExternalIncentiveReward batches of 1, 10, and 100 calls.

scopes.name: staker-incentive-rate-end
label_prefixes: Remaining staker incentive rate lifecycle EndExternalIncentive
scopes.description: After the public 90-day schedule, EndExternalIncentive finalizes the rate record and refunds remaining reward/GNS amounts.

model.delta: candidate minus baseline; negative improves cost
model.gas: Execution-segment same-price repricing, zero margin plus 5% sensitivity. Fractional ugnot retained until GNOT display. Not submitted GasFee or wallet balances; transaction/SDK/deployment overhead omitted. Same valid fixed fee has zero gas cash delta. Query-only rows have zero gas cash fee.
model.storage: Fresh-state uniformly funded per-realm model. Observed ratios and explicit assumptions are in pricing. Apply deposit/refund per realm/message before netting; proportional integer ratio is invariant under sequential changes. Initial realm snapshots are separate initialization evidence, not a deployment fee quote.
model.limits: Do not sum unrelated scopes or initial observations with overlapping lifecycle results. Repeated costs can outlive allocation savings; capital duration and deployment fees are separate.
